publicReleaseNotes: Maintenance release: Managed relay delivery, normalized sign-in hints, explicitly synthetic credential fixtures, the browser owner sign-in declaration, the rer 0.2.24 vendored Base refresh, and rer 0.2.27 for setup after local restore. No new product migrations. Product screenshot (1440 pixels): [Penny workspace](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/just-every/run-penny/v0.1.1/public/brand/releases/penny-0.1.1-1440.png), committed at public/brand/releases/penny-0.1.1-1440.png. Hosted mail delivery, hosted Cron, real Canny/UserVoice exports and whole-product acceptance remain separately unproven; see HANDOVER.md and ACCEPTANCE.md.
agentUpdateInstructions: Update from 0.1.0 with rer install and rer setup, preserving the owner, private settings, product records and existing migration history. This release adds no product migrations. Use the exact rer 0.2.27 pin; vendored Base modules retain their recorded 0.2.24 custody. Penny declares browser owner sign-in at /signin with email hint support; the claimed owner email is a hint only. Managed RER mail uses the assigned relay and existing MAIL_API_KEY; direct SendGrid and Resend settings remain explicit. Never replay ambiguous mail. login_hint only prefills a complete email and grants no authority. Local development uses the private RER_OPEN owner entry and silently suppresses mail; it has no captured-mail inbox or outbox page. Portable archives exclude native operator authority and provider secrets and disable historical requester sessions. Restore into an empty installation with the matching latest source erasure journal, then establish fresh native authority. Preserve separately approved public wording, snapshots, erasure custody and owner customizations. Live-provider, Cron and full-product acceptance limitations remain as stated in HANDOVER.md and ACCEPTANCE.md.
